description.value: Sushi Nanaimo is a Japanese restaurant situated on Nanaimo Street in East Vancouver, offering a broad menu spanning sushi, ramen, noodles, teriyaki, and more. The name refers to its street location rather than the city of Nanaimo on Vancouver Island. Online pickup ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the area.
